name: Teles
biography: A popularizing Cynic preacher of the early third century B.C. whose surviving sermons show how Cynic doctrine, diluted for a general audience in Alexandria, degenerated into a self-serving indifference toward one's obligations to others (e.g., minimizing gratitude owed to a benefactor).
